Create a database test context

Source: R/context.R
createDatabaseTestContext.Rd

The returned context is constructed only after configuration, platform, compatibility, and environment validation succeeds. It does not connect to the database eagerly. Prefer withDatabaseTestContext() when temporary credentials may be required.

Usage

createDatabaseTestContext(config, dbms = NULL, legacyAliases = NULL)

Arguments

config

A database test configuration.

dbms

Optional DBMS selection. Defaults to HADES_TEST_DBMS.

legacyAliases

Explicit normalized-to-legacy environment aliases.

Value

A panoptes_database_test_context object.
